batting.name: PC Valthaty
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b Z Khan

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b AB McDonald

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b P Awana

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b P Awana

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c N Saini b P Awana

balls.text: another slower one and he goes for a slog, misses but they are off for a single
slower, shorter and Chawla goes for another pull, this time he does not hit the middle of the bat and goes on the bounce to the deep square-leg fielder.
a slower bouncer and Chawla has pulled it away to square-leg for a four! What a start to the innings!
driven to the long-on fielder for a single
slap, flat, six! That was a good length ball and Mahmood has wasted no time in thrashing the ball and it's gone!

slower, pitched right up to the batsman and Mandeep tries to go straight this time, does not get too much distance and that is easily caught by Virat. Finally he gets out, after the many attempts in the previous couple of overs.
pitched right up to the batsman and drilled to the long-on fielder for a single.
goes for another wild heave, mishits and that has gone high in the air and...again in no man's land!
short ball and he goes for a pull, gets a top-edge and the ball lands between fine-leg and the wicket-keeper
slower, played away to long-on for a single
tries to hit over the leg-side and gets a leading edge, it goes high, spoons up to the deep square-leg region where Agarwal tries to dive and catch it. Misses and they get three
around the wicket, shorter, punched it through the in-field and it goes to long-off for a single.
slower, shorter and Mahmood is a little surprised, but adjusts quickly to play it to the covers for a single to retain strike.
another wide ball outside the off-stump with the third-man up in the circle and Mahmood has slashed it over the short third-man for a four!
good length ball and the batsman hits it on the up, over extra-cover for a couple

poor ball but that is very well-played by Azhar Mahmood! It was full and outside the off-stump, when the field was up at third-man, he dabs it in that exact region, beats Gayle and that is gone for a four!
good length ball, defended on the back-foot and they are off for a single. Mahmood has the strike again. What will this be?
short and a bit wide, cut away to the left of the sweeper fielder and they come back for the second.
and this has been spanked away for a six! Mahmood got it on the middle-stump and he swivelled around, connected and deposited it to the deep square-leg region.
on the middle, pitched up and Mahmood has hit it over mid-off for a four, almost went for a six there! Good stroke by the former Pakistani.
short ball from Patel, goes for a pull but is very early into his shot and hits the elbow, they rush off for a leg-bye
drifts on the batsman's pads and that is flicked away, hits the pads to the fine-leg for a single
jags back into the batsman, who defends it back to the bowler
round the wicket, pitched on the leg-stump, played away to square-leg for a single
on his pads and that is flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
played away to the off-side for a single
quicker on the stumps and he cuts it away yet again for a single
pitched up and he still goes for a cut, goes to the left of sweeper and they come back for the second. Was misfielded by Gayle at point.
defended on the front-foot to the ball pitched right up and gets a single
flicked it away to the leg-side for a single

bowled him! Hussey was trying to get the runs in this over, he was dropped earlier, this was a slower one and the captain went down the pitch and tried to cut it, inside-edge goes back on to the stumps.
that is an excellent shot and even better placement! Strays it on his pads and that is flicked away by Hussey through fine-leg for a four. The fine-leg was very square and Hussey gets into his 40s
short yet again, this time it is a quicker ball and he hits the middle of the bat, but goes straight to the fielder and they can get only a single.
shorter to Mandeep, goes for the pull shot off the first ball he plays and that hits high on the bat, fine-leg runs to his right
drilled to the long-on for a single
dropped! Gayle has put Hussey down, back-pedalling towards third-man. Hussey tried to slash it away, gets the bottom of the bat and it soared up in the air. That should have been third-man's catch
down the leg-side and that is a wide.
out, caught! Slower outside the off-stump, wanted to go over extra-cover, missed getting the timing right, straight into the hands of the fielder, who times it well.
outside the off-stump and played away to the point region for a single
outside the leg-stump and slower, nudges it to square-leg for a single
length ball yet again, pushed down to long-on for a single
punched back the good length ball to long-off for a run
slower, loopier, on the pads and driven to long-on for a single
in line with the stumps, pushed back and Harshal sticks his hand out to field it off his bowling. Wanted to throw down the non-striker's stumps where Hussey was backing up a little too far.
whips it wristily to long-on for a single
short yet again and Hussey has pulled it away to the left of the deep square-leg fielder. Previous ball he had got to the ball to his right but this time he is nowhere close.
shortish from Harshal and that is pulled away by Hussey for a couple. Zaheer was at mid-wicket inside the circle and he missed it by a yard or so
good length, on the back-foot and punched back to the bowler
pitched outside the leg-stump, tries to flick it away, hits the pad and they are off for a single
and now MIller drives it away for a single. Phew, another quickly bowled over.
on the leg-stump and Hussey dabs it to the leg-side to rush off for a quick single
outside the off-stump, cut away to sweeper for a single
outside the leg-stump, no turn and it is an easy call for the umpire to make
fullish this time, driven to long-off for a single
driven into the covers
on his pads from round the wickets, tried to reverse-sweep it away, hits the pads and a huge appeal. Not-out given
outside the off-stump, a bit of width and cut but straight to the point region.
neatly played away to the third-man region, point fielder runs towards the ball and fields it.
on the back-foot yet again, and pushed to the long-on fielder for a run
tries to cut that short one away, gets more bounce than what he expected, beats the bat and the wicket-keeper as they rush off for a single.
on the back-foot, pushed to long-on and they are off again. Good placement and running
on his pads, played away to deep square-leg for a single
on the back-foot yet again, slight turn away and gets an outside edge, no run.
goes on the back-foot, driven but back to the bowler for nothing
driven through the leg-side, in fact just pushed and they run away for a couple
defended and wanted to go for a run, but sent back
outside the off-stump, and Hussey flashed at it, was in air for a long time, but in the back between short third-man and point
good length, goes on the back-foot and defends it back
on the off-stump, pitched right up to the bat and driven to long-off for a single.
outside the off-stump, Hussey whips it between long-on and mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
down the leg-side, tries to nurdle it down fine-leg but misses, wide called
outside edge to the third-man fielder for a single
on the length, gets his pad across and flicks it away for a single.
good length ball, punched to the off-side for a single and he is off the mark in IPL
out, bowled! jags back into the batsman and Marsh tries to late cut it to third-man, misses it by a distance and the ball hits the top of the stumps.
short of length, flicked away by the left-handed Marsh and they rush away for a single
taken on the full, driven to long-on for a single
length ball, no turn, comes into the bat, driven to the off-side
outside the off-stump, driven to long-off for a single
changes his pace, wants to defend on the front-foot, gets an inside edge to fine-leg for a single
flicked away to the leg-side, to mid-wicket and they have come back for two
slapped, over the boundary and six! That was pitched right up to the bat, slower I think and Marsh gave it the sink, goes over the bowler's head.
slower one, driven to the leg-side for a single.
length ball, defended on the back-foot to long-on
quicker this time, outside the off-stump and driven to long-off
114.8 km/hr, pitched up, slower yet again and driven to long-on.
slower one, 109.5 km/hr, played away to third-man for a single

length ball and Hussey has only timed it back to the bowler. The only fielder who could have fielded that was the bowler and he missed it on his follow-through, the mid-on and mid-off gave chase but it races away to the fence.
good length, Marsh is holding back on the back-foot, played away to the third-man region for a run.
slower one this time, beats Marsh for pace, goes on the bounce to the wicket-keeper
half-volley and he takes his foot to the ball, transfers weight and drives through extra-cover for a four!
marginally outside the off-stump and he has beautifully carved away through point for a four! Sweet, sweet timing!
down the leg-side, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
pitched right up to the bat, outside the off-stump and he went for a lofted drive over mid-off, it does not clear the former Bangalore wicket-keeper fielding there and Punjab have lost two.
driven on the up yet again, but this time the ball drops just short of the short cover fielder. The bat seems to be turning in Valthaty's hands.
back to over the wicket, shortish and pulled, goes straighter, to mid-on
finally some confidence going for Valthaty, round the wicket from Zaheer, length ball driven on the up and that has been crashed through the covers for a four.
finally gets off the mark, with a lofted drive over the covers, Tiwary gives chase but by then the batsmen had taken two.
over the wicket, into the batsman, played away on the back-foot to the leg-side for a quick one.
bouncer, quicker than previous one and it has beaten the pull attempted by Valthaty.
short ball, outside the off-stump and he goes for the pull, connects well but straight to the fielder.
good length, moving into the batsman, defended on the back-foot and runs off. Vinay Kumar tried to play a bit of soccer to get Valthaty run-out but misses the stumps.
driven and four! outside the off-stump and a half volley, that is crashed through the covers and not too many in that region moved.
outside the off-stump, comes on to the front-foot and pushes it to the off-side again
outside the off-stump, was going for a drive before realising that it was a tad slower and checked his stroke.
outside the off-stump, punched off the back-foot to the covers and Valthaty is still to get off the mark after three overs.
back over the wicket, the ball comes in and Marsh tries to play it to the leg-side, gets a leading edge to the off-side and they are off for a run.

out, bowled 'em! Saini is bowled after Zaheer Khan came in from round the wicket, it was coming into the batsman before it jagged away a little and he tried to go over the off-side, gets his third inside-edge of the innings but this time he is not lucky enough to miss the stumps.
short ball from Zaheer and it is well pulled by Saini, goes to deep square-leg where the fine-leg fielder runs and tidies up.
tried to make room to hit through the covers, gets another inside-edge and it goes to fine, fine-leg for a couple
length ball, swinging into the pads, clipped to square-leg
goodish length, outside the off-stump with enough room to play the pull but he misses the stroke, goes through to the wicket-keeper.
short ball, Valthaty tested early by the bouncer, but he ducks under the ball well.
good length ball, defended on the front foot and it goes to mid-on
good length and defended off the back-foot, to the left of point and a quick run taken
change in length this time, shorter, but again drifting down the leg-side and that is beautifully flicked away, the fine-leg fielder needed to do exactly what he did last ball but misfields.
that is on to the pads of the batsman, good length and that is flicked away by the batsman, the fine-leg fielder ran towards the deep square region and saves it from rolling over to the fence.
pitched right up to the batsman and swinging away from the bat, wanted to come forward and defend but got nowhere near the ball. The wicket-keeper also missed it but no scoreboard damage.
on the money yet again, swinging slightly into the bat, defended on the back-foot, straight to the fielders and he allows it to go through!
shortish again, the batsman goes on to the back-foot and defends it into the covers.
on the middle, but slightly shorter, worked away to the leg-side but straight to the square-leg within the circle.
on the good length, punched off the back foot in to the covers.
pitched up, outside the off-stump but a tad slower looking for swing, gets an inside-edge and it runs to fine-leg
pitched up and driven through the coves for the winning boundary! Bangalore have their third win here...
short ball, short arm jab from Vettori gets him a single to deep mid-wicket. 2 needed from 4.
pitched up, on the middle stump and driven to long-on fielder for a single
tries to go for the drive, gets an inside edge and that goes to the deep square-leg for a single.
pitched up to the bat and driven to long-off for a single. Just that outside hope for the home fans.
driven to short cover.
gone, lbw! pitched up to the bat, goes through without turn and misses the bat, and the umpire gives him out. Was that going down?
dabbed on the off-side and they wanted to for a single, de Villiers sent him back, McDonald had to dive back.
tucked away to the leg-side for a single
pitched up, and he was on his back-foot, gets an inside-edge for a single.
short ball and defended on the back-foot.

now, now, is that a catch or what! Hussey has picked up a beauty! Slashed away by Gayle through the covers, or at least that is what one thought would happen, Hussey at extra-cover dived full length, to his right and he has taken a screamer.
full-toss and that is slashed away through the short third-man. This is not even going the distance.
short ball and that has been spanked over the deep square-leg fence for a six! That was a crowd-killer, went rather flat.
that was well-bowled, pitched right up but no-ball called.
bouncer and left alone, and for some reason, the umpire calls it a wide. That was close to the batsman, and had he no ducked, it would have hit him somewhere.
outside the off-stump and pitched up, Gayle goes over the wide long-off for a four.
bouncer and de Villiers leaves it alone expecting a wide, but the umpire lets it go.
full-toss and that is reverse-slogged by de Villiers over short third-man/short fine-leg for a four!
tries to play it to the leg-side but it hits the pad and pops back to the bowler
goes for an expansive drive, gets an inside edge and that has gone to fine-leg for a couple
down the leg-side and left alone, wide called. Well-kept by Saini but a single added
pitched right up to the bat again and AB gives himself room to go through the off-side but hits it back.
pitched up to Gayle, who drives it to long-on for a single
pitched right up, and slammed back to long-on for a single.
outside the off-stump, way outside in fact and that is a wide.
yorker, on the leg-stump and he digs it out well to the square-leg for a single
changes both, pace and length, it is slower, shorter and punched to long-off for a single
this is the over many were waiting for, pitched right up, no swing, Gayle winds up and sends it into the crowd yet again.
pitched up and that is hit rather hard back down the ground. Ravi Shastri calls it 'the poor little white thing!'
full-toss, played away to the mid-wicket fielder for a single
de Villiers moves around in the crease, drifts down the leg-side and the batsman comes back into his stance, wide called.
pushed to the off-side for a single
tries to reverse sweep it, quicker one, and misses, hits the pads, appeal from Chawla.
on the pads, Gayle taps it to the leg-side and jogs across for a single
shorter, outside the off-stump and de Villiers has played it away to the leg-side for a single
quicker and driven to the off-side.
shorter, spinning a tad and that is played to the short fine-leg.
short and pulled away to the deep square-leg region
punched away to the leg-side, in the gap between long-on and deep square-leg for a couple.
short and de Villiers has been pulled away to the fine-leg region for a four! The fielder was up in the circle and that has been easily dealt with.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single
full-toss and that is into the crowds over the bowler's head! The good news is that no-one's hurt this time.
slower one, Gayle wanted to cut it away, did not get any timing on it.
quicker, outside the off-stump and that is as wide as it can get!
that is swept away over short fine-leg for a four! Two fours in a row and the required rate is down to almost 9.
slower, pitched up and de Villiers has driven it over extra-cover for a four!
short again and Gayle dabbed it away, it looked like an easy single but Harmeet Singh at the short fine-leg tries to run him out at the non-striker's end.
short, swivelled and a couple of runs to bring up Gayle's fifty. Eighth 50 to go with 2 centuries in IPL.
this time it is fuller, in fact a high full-toss and AbD has slashed it away only for the sweeper fielder to come into action.
outside the off-stump and the batsman tries to paddle it away, but misses and it hits his pad.
leggie, gently guided away to the leg-side for a single
pitched right up yet again and Gayle cannot do much except to dig it away to the covers for a single
quicker, shorter and de Villiers has pulled it to deep square-leg for a single
pitched up again and almost in the block-hole, defended for a single
full-toss, that was quicker too and it is drilled through the wide long-off field for a four. The fielder there dived but missed him easily
outside the off-stump and driven through the covers for a couple
outside the off-stump, taken on the full, driven to the extra-cover region and only a single. The rate's gone up a wee-bit now.
length ball, played away for a single to the leg-side
a tad bit quicker this time, but pitched right up and he drives it to the long-off region for a single
slow yet again, drives to the cover fielder yet again
slower one on the off-stump and Gayle waits on it, then gently drives it to the cover fielder.
on the middle-stump and pushed to long-on for a single
leggie yet again, but this one is pitched right up to de Villiers who pushes it to wide long-on for a single.
tapped on the off side and he is off for a quick one, Gayle refused it and de Villiers slipped! Fortunately he had time to get back to the crease by the time the throw came in from point.
shorter this time, quicker attempted too and it is pulled away to fine-leg
change of pace up, pitched up to the bat and de Villiers has straight-driven it to the fence!
leg-spinner, de Villiers not only read the change of pace but also that of length and he has spanked it away to the wide long-on for a four!
full-toss and bludgeoned back, the fielder at long-on was pretty straight, only a single
back to pitching on the legs and Gayle drives it to the leg-side for a single
finally, teed off! It was on the middle-stump and Gayle smacked it over the bowler with a fine flourish towards the end
shorter and pushed to the off-side for a single
on his pads, pushed to the leg-side for a single
flighted, pitched up and drilled through the covers for a single
leg-spinner on the pads, without any fielder within the circle on the leg-side and flicked away for a couple
outside the off-stump and that it drilled through the gap between point and short third-man, yet again no real sign of aggression and it almost goes to the fence.
another leg-spinner and Gayle has played it so gently to the deep square-leg fielder that one wouldn't have thought it would go for a couple!
pitched right up yet again, and de Villiers drives it well to long-off
pitched right up to the bat and drilled to the long-off for a single.
leg-spinner, read well and played it to the deep square-leg for a couple of runs.
moves in the crease, towards the off-side, probably wanting to play to the leg-side, leading edge and gets a single
bowled from wide of the crease, angling away and Gayle defends back to the bowler
short, quick and punched to the covers.
outside the leg-stump to de Villiers too, quick as well, flicked away to the leg-side for a single
bowls outside the leg-stump, turns it away to the leg-side for a single. No turn for Chawla so far.
quicker on the middle stump and defended back to the bowler
no spin, goes straight on, punched through the covers for a single
down the leg-side, touches something on the way through to the keeper, appeal but the umpire thinks it is off the pads and that ends the over. No reason to believe it touched anything else.
pitched up and that has been gracefully played through the covers. Caressed! Four through the covers
138.2 km/hr, pitched right up to the bat, outside edge and that has beaten the slips and the third-man for a four!
138.3 km/hr, punched through the covers and that beats the in-field, good chase by Valthaty and he saves one there
outside the off-stump and defended on the back-foot to the off-side.

caught off a top-edge and Awana has his third! Tiwary was almost walking down the pitch to go for the shot, the pace was too hot for him to handle, climbed on quickly on to him, gets a top-edge and that goes to the wicket-keeper for a simple catch.
on his pads and that is pushed away to the leg-side for a single.
on his pads and that is defended, almost off a straight bat, gives it a flick off the last fraction of a second and that rolls away to the fine-leg
shorter length this time and pushed off the back-foot to the leg-side for a single
from around the wicket now, outside the off-stump, coming into the batsman and he shoulders arms.
on his pads yet again, he defends, hits his pads and they are off for another single
on his pads and nudged away to wide mid-on for a single. Gayle will be itching to have a go at PK here now.
goes down the wicket yet again and goes for a pull, misses because of the pace and it is through to the wicket-keeper. End of another excellent over from Awana.
137.2 km/hr, on the off-stump, punched it to mid-off.
short ball, well bowled, Gayle was coming down the track and the bowler gave it his all, lets it go through to the wicket-keeper
another quick ball, 138.5 km/hr, short of a good length and defended on the back-foot.
140.1 km/hr, on the middle stump yet again, and defended on the leg-side for a quick single
on the middle stump, good length and defended back to the bowler
slower one and Gayle had to wait for its arrival, defended back to the bowler.
pitched outside leg and hitting the pads, an appeal for lbw, negated and rightly so.
in the air and almost taken! Leading edge, towards Marsh and he dives to his right at point and takes it on the bounce.
back to bowling on his legs and it is played away to the fine-leg, where there is nobody and the chase from deep square-leg goes futile!
spanked away by Gayle and that goes on the bounce and over the cover fielder. A bit of room is all he needed.
127.3 km/hr, on the middle, defended by Gayle.
down the leg-side yet again from PK, probably to cramp Gayle for room.

gone, caught! Leading edge and caught at point! Checking for the no-ball, but the boot is well in. It was outside the off-stump, pitched up and Kohli went for the drive, gets an edge and it flies to Marsh fielding at point, that is well-taken by the fielder and Bangalore are two down all of a sudden!
outside the off-stump, pulling his length back a little and punched into the covers, fielded well by MIller
141.8 km/hr, pitched up, outside the off-stump and defended back. That is quick bowling!
outside the off-stump, moving slightly away and edged away to the third-man fence for a four!
gone, lbw! Plumb! Good length ball, and Agarwal was moving towards the ball, this one hit the pads before he could get his bat down and the umpire's finger was up in a flash.
on the pads, short of a good length, turned away to square-leg for a single
defended stylishly, to mid-off for a single.
down the leg-side, tried to get some swing from there, left alone by Gayle and it is a wide.
pitched up for a change, again swinging away from the bat and driven to the cover fielder.
shorter from PK, no swing and punched back to the bowler.
pitched slightly up and swinging away from Gayle, missed and the keeper was up to the stumps to take it.
short of length yet again, and tries to punch it, gets an inside edge to the leg-side, trot off for a single
outside the off-stump, short of length and swinging a bit, back into the bat, defended.
